title: When parsing a report descriptor, usage pages should apply to usage minimum/maximum
body:
Step 23 of the ["Parsing the report descriptor" section](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-parsing-the-report-descriptor) contains for Local Items:

> If item is a [Local item](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-local-items):
>    1. Let value be the [item data field](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-item-data-field) interpreted as an unsigned long.
>    2. If item has the [Usage tag](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-usage-tag):
>         1. If item's [bSize field](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-bsize-field) is 1 or 2:
>             1. Let usageId be an unsigned short containing the lower 16 bits of value.
>             2. Let globalState be the last [item](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-item) of globalStack.
>             3. Set value to a [HID usage](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-hid-usages) composed of globalState["[usagePage](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidcollectioninfo-usagepage)"] in the high order bits and usageId in the low order bits.
>        2. [Append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) value to usages.
>    3. If item has the [Usage Minimum tag](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-usage-minimum-tag), then set localState["[usageMinimum](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-usageminimum)"] to value.
>    4. If item has the [Usage Maximum tag](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-usage-maximum-tag), then set localState["[usageMaximum](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-usagemaximum)"] to value.

This correctly applies the usage page to Usage tags but not Usage Minimum tags nor Usage Maximum tags. The HID spec (section 6.2.2.8) states that usage pages should apply to these as well.
